@Dharleth kindly noted that there were incorrect tracks in my original torrent. This fixes that. Also, there are different versions for tracks 12-18 as they're from Tsukihime (tracks 1-4, 6, 8 and 5 respectively):
- [Original](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uvZhx40qqbO0d3vqLXuvvt2Z__tgk3hP)
- [Tsuki-Bako](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nQQz6qcD1VRw5vZBCPKI0r56I_MyJWcy)
- [Ever After](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nFaMrHurlMiZwsI-SAd7pv7kejOoMeJe) (the one included in this release)

The PC (Windows) version of Kagetsu Tohya. It is a fandisc for Tsukihime. It's ~~recommended~~ required that you complete every route in [Tsukihime](https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/181368) and the short [Tsukihime Plus+Disc](https://nyaa.si/view/453758)  first before playing this.

**The game has already been patched and is ready to go. Just launch the game with "Kagetsu Tohya.exe".**

Changes:
- Replaced and tagged all tracks with the ones from [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uvZhx40qqbO0d3vqLXuvvt2Z__tgk3hP?usp=sharing)
- Added omake.zip to the _bonus_ directory which includes the track list, some short stories and other stuff in Japanese from the original Kagetsu Tohya's Tsuki-Bako disk

Also, there are no pre-existing savefiles in this release, which means that "Skip parts previously read" function works correctly and all the CGs which, at the beginning shouldn't be unlocked, aren't unlocked.
